# `Q-2-57` — Invalid `fig-align` value on a diagram cell

> A diagram cell's `fig-align` must be `left`, `center`, `right`, or
> `default`; any other value is ignored.

## What this means

`fig-align` places a diagram on the page:

```` markdown
```mermaid
%%| fig-align: left
flowchart LR
  A --> B
```
````

Quarto understands four values. `left`, `center`, and `right` say where
the diagram goes; `default` means `center`. Any other value raises this
warning, and Quarto ignores the option: the diagram is placed as if
`fig-align` were absent.

## How to fix

Change the value to one of the four. A common slip is a word from
another vocabulary, such as `middle` or `start`. CSS-style values are
not accepted either.
